subject: Command-line Stan now builds for 64-bit Windows

messages.subject: Command-line Stan now builds for 64-bit Windows
parts:
This is great --- now we can build 64-bit Windows targets.

Daniel and I learned that this was possible when validating the RStan
installs on Windows. Turns out RStan was doing it all along.

Thanks, Jiqiang!

- Bob
